About Lilia

Lilia Stasenya — international newborn & maternity photographer with 8+ years experience and 1200+ sessions worldwide.

Workshops in 13 countries across Europe & Middle East. Jury member at international competitions. I want the same for you.

My style is rooted in minimalism and lifestyle photography — a timeless approach that will look as beautiful in 50 years as it does today. Every session is about real emotions, tender connection, and creating art that speaks to the heart.
